operations.idempotency: event.id + identical payload returns the existing result; same id with different payload is a conflict
operations.reconciliation: after an unknown response, query the event before retrying; a matching active event is the terminal success result

operations.idempotency: event.id + identical payload + base version returns the existing replacement; same request id with different payload is a conflict
operations.ambiguousResponse: query GET /api/events?babyId=:babyId&includeVoided=true and match the replacement event's correctedFromId
operations.reconciliation: after an unknown response, query the source event and its replacement before retrying; never create a second replacement

operations.idempotency: event.id + the same version is safe to repeat; an already voided tombstone is the terminal result
operations.ambiguousResponse: query GET /api/events?babyId=:babyId&includeVoided=true and match event.id status=voided
operations.reconciliation: after an unknown response, query the event; if status=voided report success, otherwise retry once with the latest version

errorSemantics.offlineFacts: never queue or report a fact as saved without server confirmation

equivalentAudit: every accepted write is represented by the same care_events revision/audit fields regardless of Web or Harmony caller
